caption: The drawing depicts a geometric, symmetrical composition made up of four square blocks arranged in a larger square, separated by a cross formed from bold vertical and horizontal bars in red and green. Each of the four blocks is constructed from a series of concentric rectangles and squares, with color patterns repeating in each block. The colors used include green, light blue, tan, red, black, brown, white, purple with orange circular patterns, and dark blue. The background is a plain off-white. Each block features an internal sequence using the same palette, and the blocks are bordered by a pale green frame. The piece is bordered by a rectangular margin, and the artist's name "Ruth Barnes" is written at the lower right, with the label "A.3250" at the lower left.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
